notes: SHIP v1.14.388 - PHASE 2 DESKTOP BUILD WORKSPACE. Build now opens INSIDE the Phase 1 persistent Command Shell: the sidebar and topbar stay on screen and only the centre workspace changes, with the sidebar BUILD item active. Two purpose-built compositions, matching the three-shell ruling. LAPTOP 851-1499: one dominant workspace (hero, rack preview, metrics, actions) plus one 320px context rail (Next Action, Active Blockers, Local State), with the rack queue as a full-width band below - no third narrow column. FULL DESKTOP 1500+: a true three-region Mission Control at 260px / 1fr / 320px - left rack queue, centre workspace, right context - verified at 1600 as 260/688/320 with the columns in the correct left-to-right order. THE PHONE COMPOSITION IS UNTOUCHED, BY CONSTRUCTION: every block is placed with CSS Grid grid-template-areas, so DOM ORDER NEVER CHANGES and the approved phone Build order still renders exactly as it did in .385. The two new contextual columns are display:none by default and only appear under body.rd.cshell at 851+. WHAT THE NEW COLUMNS SHOW, ALL REAL: the rack queue carries a live tally of complete / active / blocked / pending computed from each rack rollup, every rack row with its real phase and percentage, and the current rack highlighted. Active Blockers lists only racks whose phases are genuinely blocked, with the real blockerNote, and says so plainly when nothing is blocking. Local State is honest about an app that has no sync: writes are immediate so pending changes is None, last local save comes from the deployment timestamp, and synchronization reads on-device only, no sync target configured - stated positively per the offline-first law, never as a failure or a fake synced tick. The 3D preview grows to 340px on laptop and 420px on full desktop using the SAME rackElevation_render3D; scene internals untouched. A DEFECT WORTH RECORDING - THE THIRD TIME THIS PATTERN HAS BITTEN THIS SHELL: the desktop rules did not apply at first because the phone rule is body.rd #pg-work #bw-shell, which carries TWO ids and out-specifies a class-scoped body.rd.cshell selector. display:grid silently lost and every block spanned full width. Caught by measuring - all five blocks reported the same 1138px width and 274px left - not by looking. Every #bw-shell desktop rule now carries #pg-work. Id-scoped legacy rules beat class-scoped shell rules, and that is now three for three. DEVICE-VERIFY: at ?shell=1 tap BUILD - the sidebar and topbar must stay, BUILD must be the active nav item, and there must be no bottom nav. At 1440: hero left, context rail right, rack queue below. At 1600+: three columns, queue on the left. CONTINUE, OPEN AISLE, SCAN, PORT MAP and LOG BLOCKER all still route to their existing screens. Phone at 390 must be unchanged from .385, and ?legacy=1 unchanged. STILL OPEN: the FRONT/ISO/TOP/REAR + CABLES rail inline on the preview card, the contextual Port Map / BOM / Manifest / Rack Map tabs in the centre workspace, and the worklist and evidence actions - all next in this program.
